orgDesign.companyProfile: Dawn describes a specialist software group; Vortex describes acquisition integration and a shared-services center. The cited public scale measures count different populations and do not establish an internal organization chart.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Proposed nine-team slice with 73 team members and three group coordination roles (76 modeled roles). This is neither a complete company headcount nor the actual Dawn organization. Client-specific squads may combine these capabilities. Chapters share practice; engagement owners retain client accountability. Assurance is an enabling function with human client approval; reliability coordinates contracted support while application teams own code repair.
orgDesign.headcountBasis: Capacity hypothesis for this modeled product/delivery slice; excludes other client teams, sales, finance, people operations and group leadership. Validate actual demand and coverage before treating this as a staffing plan.
